tests.scope: Actual Win32 and retained-original-child cross-process tests in source only. Close-fault injection is a controlled refusal test in an independent child, not an observed OS CloseHandle failure.

api.discovery: InstallIdentity::for_current_user() -> Result<InstallIdentity>; opaque current SID plus OS-resolved LocalAppData, fixed upgrade family. No caller path/SID/property.
api.startup: LifecycleGate::acquire_startup(&identity) -> Result<StartupLease>; shared read gate, Pending absence under same retained gate. Explicit try_release(&mut self), no positive Drop receipt.
api.maintenance: LifecycleGate::try_begin_maintenance(&identity, MaintenanceOperation, original_deadline:Instant) -> Result<MaintenanceOwner>; exclusive same physical gate; original UUID and Pending inode create-new/write/Flush/readback.
api.physicalGuardian: MaintenanceOwner::watch_guardian(&Child) -> GuardianIdentity; duplicate original process object, exact current-user token, PID/FILETIME. No arbitrary command/path launch.
api.settle: record_settlement(Settlement) requires original OperationId+guardian identity, Join/End0, broker effects_reconciled and original process signaled with exit0. try_release rechecks original deadline, Pending inode/bytes and actual guardian return; explicit handle-based deletion and checked closes.

resources.retention: Fixed process-global ledger per original claim. Close failure retains remaining raw handle capabilities, sticky rejects all new operations; no native reuse/retry, no unsafe Send/Sync. Process exit final recovery.

security.path: Fixed local drive only; all ancestors open reparse-self and reject reparse; retained no-DELETE directory pins; regular files one hardlink only. No generic temporary/user path public API.
security.acl: LocalAppData exact token owner and valid DACL without effective untrusted write/delete/owner/ACL grants; no mutation/repair. Own root/gate/Pending exact protected two allow ACEs current SID+SYSTEM and exact current SID owner; handle-based queries. Service tokens refused.
security.negative: Any Pending presence blocks; malformed/torn/unknown/no guardian/owner dead/deadline expired never implies liveness or release. Drop never deletes Pending. Missing Pending after an owner has claimed it cannot pass exact inode/bytes verification.
security.testCleanup: Test-only random namespace injection and exact known file removal after actual child reap; no recursive production deletion.

boundaries: Not wired into normal/autostart/repair or MSI/broker; no claim current product protected.

Settlement is trusted broker input, not an authenticated IPC receipt. Broker must still bind actual installed helper image/hash/engine transaction, reconcile exact effects and handle rollback skipped errors before setting effects_reconciled. No complete MSI lifecycle approval here.
No stale Pending recovery, automatic timeout cleanup, Run mutation, school-data access, application start, registry/services/firewall/trust changes.
No universal power-failure guarantee from FlushFileBuffers; real reboot/fault cases pending.
No Cargo/Windows/SSH/CI/install performed. Win7/Win10/Win11 runtime qualification separate; root owns unified build and tests.
